estimand: Descriptive candidate-beat detection agreement across all raw ECG channels in complete recording-relative windows; no validated R peaks, NN intervals, HRV, or subject inference
filter_application: sosfiltfilt on each full resampled 300-second window before trimming; exploratory engineering specification
amplitude_method: Peaks of abs(5-20Hz filtered ECG), prominence >=3*block MAD; globally enforce 250ms distance with larger absolute amplitude first
energy_method: Squared derivative averaged over centered 100ms; block median+3*MAD threshold; refine to maximum absolute filtered amplitude within +/-80ms; globally enforce 250ms distance
matching: One-to-one chronological maximum-cardinality pairing within 50ms; agreement is 2*matched/(nA+nB), undefined for two empty sets
intervals: All successive candidate intervals within each window, no clipping, ectopic removal, interpolation, or bridging windows; not NN intervals
threshold_interpretation: Exploratory signal-processing choices, not clinical acceptance thresholds; report all channels and both methods without best-channel selection
gate_note: Gate applies only to clean/inverted synthetic cases; other cases report limitations, do not certify clinical performance
